summary.one_line: The final Markdown set and full-field figures align with the captured records; eight draft advisories remain without certifying game facts.

purpose.evidence: Read all 22 Markdown paths, including the revised neutral-army explanation pair. Nine RU/EN page pairs have clear purposes: landing, about/contributing, player/modding methods and format/placement explanations. The placement title promises the game's deployment mechanism, and its opening limits scope to investigated Universe behavior. All 18 site pages remain draft; this review does not certify complete game mechanics.

structure.evidence: Compared all 18 page frontmatter records with CONTRIBUTING: two landing, four meta, six explanation, four how-to and two reference pages, matched in RU/EN pairs. The placement explanation now pairs full 2D diagrams with footprint and row stages and shows three battles. Every generated positions SVG includes both armies, full 16x12 cell grid, blocked mask, footprint labels and X/Y axes; footprint/approach layers are explicitly teaching illustrations.

specificity.evidence: Compared new public data with authorized raw grid and Start records for pack_8, pack_15 and pack_12: all three masks, attacker/defender types and starting anchors match exactly. Tables and figures show A1 angel (3,4), pack_8 N1 genie (13,4) with 2x2 square, pack_15 N4 pit fiend (13,4) with 2x2 square, and pack_12 elemental anchors. Illustrative candidate (8,6) intersects a recorded obstacle; approach caption's Y=2 L=0 and Y=1 L=2 match the static mask. These displays do not establish why each cell was selected.

reproducibility.evidence: The tracked generator and `npm run figures` produce SVGs from observations.json, and `python scripts/render-placement.py --check` passed in this review. Parent reports 8 Node, 13 Python, 11 browser tests and 19 HTML pages passing. Article includes both-army Start callback and distinguishes pre-turn coordinates/static masks from early-combat frames. Exact WorkshopPolygon map remains unpublished, so identical arenas cannot be independently reproduced; this remains an advisory draft limit. I did not run the game.

evidence.evidence: Checked algorithm explanation against the authorized research note's later corrections: unreachable merging, world/local guard coordinate mismatch, CombatSize rather than tier, fixed battlefield with variable deployment depth, and equal-score sorting. Public observations.json reproduces all three authorized raw grid masks and Start unit lists, states predictor unloaded and post-recording delay, and its pack_15/pack_12 screenshot hashes match published PNG bytes. Owner-approved camera record was supplied for pack_15; I did not independently recreate that pose, inspect game binaries, or certify every code-analysis claim.

applicability.evidence: The placement pair pins investigated Heroes V Tribes of the East with Universe and EXE hash, separates game mechanism from a predictor, and labels overlays as illustrative rather than observed placements. Three battles vary both armies/obstacles, so the article does not claim isolated causality. It also discloses post-Start effects, temporary capture delay, unpublished map and unknown exact source camera pose. Other modes/builds are not asserted equivalent.

translations.evidence: Checked all nine reciprocal RU/EN pairs and matching content_type/status/faction. The revised placement pair agrees on full grid directions, A/N legend, three battles and coordinate tables, 2x2 footprints, hypothetical candidate, approach layer, Start timing, predictor absence, camera limits and unpublished map. README/CONTRIBUTING/AGENTS/NOTICE add matching RU/EN diagram guidance. Link/HTML checks passed per parent.

maintenance.evidence: CONTRIBUTING owns the full-field diagram rule; AGENTS and README point to canonical observations.json and `npm run figures`. Generator emits five SVGs in loops and check rejects stale output or invalid/overlapping footprints. Article links all five current diagrams and two distinct battle photos; NOTICE distinguishes game art from original diagrams. review:info still lists all 22 cumulative Markdown paths; any next content change needs an exact-diff review.
